prompt: Photographs filled with many small, separated marks or objects distributed across a relatively continuous visual field; thumbnail-scale speckled, dotted, scattered or lightly stippled appearance.
looseness: Composition, hue, sparsity, density, regularity, orientation, object type and scale may vary.
exclusions: Known derivatives, related captures/sequences, non-photographs, fabricated patterns, single dominant foreground objects.
interpretation: Visual curation only. Discovery buckets and source identities are not similarity labels or expected clusters.
